description:
A Prudential é uma empresa global de 150 anos de história com presença em mais de 50 países e estamos há mais de 27 anos ajudando a minimizar o impacto financeiro que um imprevisto pode representar na vida de milhares de famílias brasileiras. Somos a maior seguradora independente no segmento de vida e tivemos uma média de crescimento de 27% de faturamento no país nos últimos 10 anos.

Com crescimento sólido, reputação global e líder de mercado, nos dedicamos a oferecer soluções inovadoras e personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para nossos clientes.

Descrição do cargo

MOVIDOS POR PROTEGER, INSPIRADOS POR PESSOAS. Aqui na Prudential, oferecemos soluções personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para milhões de brasileiros. Nosso propósito e crescimento acelerado nos posicionaram como a maior seguradora independente no segmento de pessoas (excluindo VGBL) . É com muito orgulho que alcançamos mais de 5 milhões de vidas protegidas no Brasil.

A Prudential do Brasil é um lugar para realizar em meio a um time que valoriza a colaboração. Se nosso símbolo é o rochedo, a nossa força são nossas pessoas, suas histórias e seu repertório.

SOBRE A POSIÇÃO:

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Gestão de base de dados: Consolidar informações de todas as áreas da diretoria financeira (FP&A, capital, despesas, reportes); Criar e manter estruturas de banco de dados relacionais (SQL, SQLite, MySQL, ou similares); Garantir qualidade, integridade e segurança das informações.
  • Automação de processos: Desenvolver soluções de automação para atividades recorrentes, como geração de relatórios, dashboards e apresentações em PowerPoint a partir de base de dados; Implementar scripts e rotinas (e.g. em python); Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas para entender processos e propor melhorias baseadas em tecnologia.
  • Integração de dados e insights: Desenvolver ferramentas que permitam correlacionar diferentes bens e métricas financeiras, identificando relações de causa e efeito; Apoiar a diretoria na evolução para análises preditivas e prescritivas, ajudando na tomada de decisões estratégicas; Suportar análises avançadas como detecção de tendências, riscos e impactos em cenários futuros.

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação superior em Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em gestão e modelagem de bases de dados (SQL, MySQL, SQLite ou equivalentes);
  • Conhecimento sólido em linguagens de programação (e.g. python), com experiência em bibliotecas para automação e geração de relatórios (ex.: Pandas, OpenPyXL, python-pptx);
  • Desejável vivência em business intelligence e ferramentas como Power BI ou Tableau;
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar relações complexas entre dados e traduzí-las em insights acionáveis;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com habilidade para interagir com diferentes áreas e níveis hierárquicos.

Será um diferencial se você também tiver:

  • Experiência em automação de apresentações e relatórios corporativos;
  • Conhecimento em estatística aplicada e técnicas de machine learning voltadas para análise preditiva;
  • Vivência prévia em áreas financeiras ou em empresas de grande porte;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para lidar com reportes e integração com matriz.

Para isso, buscamos alguém que tenha...

  • Autonomia, colaboração e adaptabilidade;
  • Senso de urgência, compromisso com qualidade e prazos;
  • Comunicação assertiva;
  • Capacidade analítica e senso crítico.

Aqui você tem flexibilidade com nosso modelo de trabalho híbrido (3x2). Essa posição será baseada no Rio de Janeiro.

title: Country Finance Manager - Brazil & Argentina
description:
Country Finance Manager - Brazil & Argentina

Join to apply for the Country Finance Manager - Brazil & Argentina role at Accelleron

Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Job Description

  • As the key financial leader for Area Brazil and Argentina, you will act as copilot of the Country Managing Director (CMD) and be responsible for all local finance and commercial management matters.
  • Partnering closely with the CMD, you will play a critical role in steering the direction and success of the organization by providing timely and accurate financial insights and demonstrating strong business acumen.
  • You will lead and oversee all aspects of controlling, accounting, reporting, internal control, commercial management, fiduciary responsibilities, treasury, and tax matters to sustainably optimize business performance and financial position.
  • Representing the company externally, you will ensure full compliance with all legal requirements and internal policies.
  • The Country Finance Manager (CFM) reports to the Global Division Controller & Commercial Manager Service and the Country Managing Director.

Your Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Contribute to the local implementation of the Accelleron business strategy, providing strategic financial leadership and direction.
  • Business Planning: Develop and translate strategy into comprehensive business plans (budget/forecast), set measurable targets, and coordinate/oversee the corresponding processes. Assess financial implications of strategic decisions, create, and evaluate business scenarios, and initiate corrective actions when necessary.
  • Performance Management and decision support: Monitor financial performance across multiple dimensions, delivering insights to support both operational and strategic decision-making. Drive cost structure optimization, productivity improvements, and capital efficiency to maximize value creation.
  • Commercial and Risk Management: Identify and communicate commercial and financial risks and opportunities arising from business propositions, such as contracts. Conduct risk and contract reviews in line with global policies and standards to minimize risks and exposure. Monitor overdue accounts to mitigate default risk and safeguard company assets.
  • Financial Reporting: Establish and oversee processes and tools to ensure transparent and reliable financial data, reported in compliance with Group standards (US-GAAP) and financial closing schedules.
  • Accounting and Statutory Reporting: Ensure accurate financial bookkeeping (via our external Accounting Service Provider) in accordance with local accounting principles. Ensure timely preparation of accurate statutory financial statements.
  • Tax Compliance: Responsible for the preparation and filing of accurate tax returns (including timely payment) for corporate income taxes, transfer pricing and indirect taxes, in collaboration with your tax service provider. Ensure adherence to Accelleron tax policies as well as local and international tax regulations to ensure full tax compliance. Monitor changes in local tax legislation and assess their impact with local and global experts.
  • Governance, Compliance, and Audits: Establish and maintain local governance in line with corporate standards, regulations, policies, and legal requirements. Ensure effective execution of internal controls for financial and specified non-financial operations. Coordinate external audits and support internal audits, acting as a liaison with the global legal and integrity function. Act as Secretary to the Board of Directors. Ensure regulatory filings, reporting, and other general affairs tasks.
  • Treasury Management: Secure, plan and manage the company’s liquidity, including investment and debt management. Responsible for the local bank relationships, including the management of bank accounts, bank guarantees and other local banking services. Identify and manage foreign exchange risks, implementing hedging strategies in accordance with Group policies. Oversee the company's local insurance policies and credit risk management in alignment with Group guidelines.

Your Background

  • University degree in Finance/Controlling or Chartered Financial Accountant (e.g., ACCA, ACA, ICAEW, ICAS, CPA, CIMA) or extensive practical work experience with demonstrated achievements.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of local statutory accounting principles (BR GAAP, ARG GAAP) and US-GAAP/IFRS, combined with practical application experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in tax compliance, specifically in preparing and filing corporate income tax returns, managing transfer pricing, and handling indirect taxes.
  • Strong financial background with a structured and results-oriented approach and exceptional analytical skills.
  • High IT proficiency with experience in SAP (S4Hana is a strong advantage) and Microsoft Office products.
  • Proven team player with strong problem-solving skills, an open-minded approach to challenges, and the persistence to deliver on time.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, ideally with corresponding work experience from within a matrix organization.
  • 7+ years of experience in a controlling/accounting role within an international environment, preferably with an industrial background.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills with a commitment to coaching and developing team members to reach their professional goals.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is a must, while proficiency in Spanish is a strong advantage

Your Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package
  • International development opportunities
  • Modern office environment with flexible working arrangements
  • Lunch allowances
  • Insurance policy
  • Employee Assistance program

title: Client Experience Operations Specialist
description:
Toptal launches HireGlobal The most competitively priced global workforce payroll platform.

Client Experience Operations Specialist

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

As a member of our Toptal Service Center team, you will work closely with the Director, Client Experience, and the leadership of the Toptal Service Center to ensure we have the data, tools, and workflows needed to operate at our best. You will be responsible for extracting and analyzing data from Tableau, SQL, and Zendesk, creating clear insights and reporting packages for leadership. You will also own and optimize our support systems (Zendesk, Slack, automations), helping to streamline workflows and improve efficiency across the organization.

Our ideal candidate has outstanding discipline, is highly passionate, and is eager to learn, grow, and develop. You will thrive in a fast-paced environment and strive to go above and beyond to effectively resolve clients’ and client services’ inquiries, issues, and concerns while maintaining a high level of client satisfaction.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

  • Leverage SQL, Zendesk, and Tableau to analyze data and deliver actionable insights and reporting packages for the Customer Support leadership team.
  • Own and optimize Zendesk configuration (queues, triggers, macros, automations) and support tools such as Slack workflows and Zapier integrations to improve efficiency and reduce manual work.
  • Work collaboratively with the team’s managers and cross-functional partners (Product, Engineering, and Operations) to ensure systems and workflows align with business needs.
  • Act with a sense of ownership in identifying process gaps, recommending improvements, and implementing scalable solutions.
  • Maintain process documentation and act as a subject matter expert for tools, data extraction, and reporting practices.
  • Support ad-hoc analysis and operational projects, providing leadership with the insights needed for decision-making.
  • Assist with training and onboarding for team members on tools, workflows, and data processes.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Become familiar with the various platforms and systems Toptal utilizes to offer timely and exceptional client support.
  • Complete customized onboarding to successfully navigate through the organization and understand the moving parts that make up the Toptal business model.
  • Rapidly begin learning about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision, with a focus on the state of the talent industry, the Future of Work, and the core messages important to Toptal.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Familiarize yourself with the extensive support materials available to successfully support our clients and talent.
  • Learn the key internal and external stakeholders and how clients can best be served by the different Toptal teams during their lifecycle.
  • Have a solid understanding of the Toptal platform as it relates to clients and the most frequent request processes.
  • Effectively and independently resolve client issues.
  • Gain a comprehensive working knowledge of the client experience from start to finish.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Confidently onboard to our support organization, tools, and workflows.
  • Built strong working relationships with the Director and Support Managers.
  • Be comfortable extracting data from Tableau, SQL, and Zendesk to produce accurate weekly and ad-hoc reports.
  • Learn and document our existing Zendesk setup, Slack workflows, and automations.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Be recognized as the “go-to” person for data extraction, workflow troubleshooting, and Zendesk admin needs.
  • Independently produce reporting packages and insights that help leadership make decisions.
  • Deliver at least 2–3 workflow or automation improvements that save the team measurable time.
  • Actively document processes and creating clarity around how tools and data are used.
  • Start to contribute ideas for larger process or system enhancements.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Be fully confident operating as the operational backbone of the support organisation while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Anticipate leadership needs by proactively surfacing insights, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead small-to-medium operational projects (queue redesign, automation rollouts, feature pilots).
  • Establish clear reporting and automation processes that run smoothly without micromanagement.
  • Be trusted as both a subject matter expert in tools and a partner in shaping how support operates at scale.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 3+ years of experience in operations roles.
  • Intermediate SQL proficiency is required.
  • Strong proficiency with G Suite tools, especially tools for analysis and reporting.
  • Zendesk admin experience, including managing queues, triggers, macros, and dashboard setup, is a strong advantage.
  • Comfortable extracting data from Tableau.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools, such as Zapier and Slack workflows.
  • Collaborative. Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong, customer-centric relationships, both internally and externally.
  • Team-oriented. Cooperative and promotes an environment of continuous improvement.
  • Problem solver. Must be capable of uncovering issues and resolving them quickly and effectively.
  • Time management. Must be able to work independently and manage multiple priorities without constant supervision.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

Toptal is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

title: Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Canonical has a large and rapidly growing kernel team that underpins Ubuntu and open source more widely across a very wide range of hardware and use cases.

We care most about hardware and virtualization enablement, security, reliability and performance. Kernel Team projects include but are not limited to:

  • Ubuntu Linux kernel plan, execution, benchmarking and stress testing
  • Optimized kernels for key silicon and cloud partners
  • Confidential computing and next-generation security primitives
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Kernel Livepatch, which delivers critical kernel fixes without rebooting
  • FIPS compliance
  • Real-Time and Low Latency kernel variants and patch-sets
  • Virtualization or abstraction engines
  • Container technology
  • Security with AppArmor, SECCOMP, namespaces and more
  • Networking - in particular performance and security
  • Storage - we are particularly interested in Ceph and DRBD

We hire candidates of all experience levels from recent university graduates through seasoned industry experts. You must have outstanding academic results, a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.

Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and – with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan – have no offices and therefore no pressure to work from an office.

What the role entails

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of a flavour of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Solid background with git
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Understanding of Linux kernel upstream processes and release cycle
  • Performance engineering and security experience
  • Solid background in CI/CD and process automation
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.

title: [Ambev Global Tech] Tech Compliance Specialist
description:
Overview

The Tech Compliance Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring the security and compliance of global IT solutions across the organization. This specialist will support the design, implementation, and management of security and compliance programs, monitor key performance indicators, and help drive continuous improvement in line with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities and Attributions

  • Support the design, implementation, and management of global IT security and compliance programs.
  • Monitor and maintain Security & Compliance (S&C) KPIs and SLAs, proactively addressing deviations to ensure targets are consistently met.
  • Assist in aligning external audit scope with business needs; participate in audit deficiency remediation and closure discussions.
  • Develop, document, and enforce policies and procedures to safeguard sensitive data, mitigate IT risks, and ensure compliance.
  • Conduct regular risk assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities, assess controls, and implement corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and partners to design and implement effective security controls, including access and vulnerability management.

description:
Data Analyst: A/B-tests and customer onboarding (Remote)

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents.

Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so. Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries.

We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

About the Data Science Integrations team

Providing measurable KPI lifts is the goal of our platform, and most customers want to prove it running an A/B-test against either an in-house solution or one of our competitors. The Data Science Integrations team ensures that we run successful A/B tests at scale while minimizing manual engineering effort.

The team owns the customer onboarding process from a data quality standpoint, verifies the quality of customer integrations and tracking, and ensures that Constructor algorithms work as expected when ramping out tests to live customers. As a member of the Data Science Integrations team, you will use world-class analytical, engineering and data processing techniques to build the foundational infrastructure, tooling and analytical capabilities to enable the business to move forward.

Challenges you will tackle

  • Take initiative and perform data exploration to understand user behavior, suggest opportunities for improving our recommender & search systems, and implement pipelines for data delivery, as well as UX/UI changes
  • Ideate and deliver analytical insights to merchandizers to enable effective decision making and provide the best possible results during evaluation
  • Help the Customer Success team to communicate with merchandizers, fulfill their needs during integration, and provide best results for online metrics
  • Collaborate with the Customer Integrations team to make sure customers are integrated without bugs and with sufficient tracking to power data pipelines and models for search engine

Requirements

  • You are proficient in BI tools (data analysis, building dashboards for engineers and non-technical folks)
  • You are an excellent communicator with the ability to translate business asks into a technical language and vice versa
  • You are excited to leverage massive amounts of data to drive product innovation & deliver business value
  • You're familiar with math statistics (A/B-tests)
  • You are proficient at SQL (any variant), well-versed in exploratory data analysis with Python (pandas & numpy, data visualization libraries)
  • You are adept at fast prototyping and providing analytical support for initiatives in the e-commerce space by identifying & focusing on relevant features & metrics
  • You are willing to develop and maintain effective communication tools to report business performance and inform decision-making at a cross-functional level

Benefits

  • Unlimited vacation time
  • Fully remote team
  • Work from home stipend
  • Apple laptops provided for new employees
  • Training and development budget for every employee
  • Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees
  • Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact
  • Base salary range between $80k and $120k USD
  • Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

Join to apply for the Sr. Support Engineer, SAP Hana/Basis role at Rimini Street

Position Summary

The role of the Sr. Support Engineer, SAP Hana/Basis is to provide exceptional remote-based support for mission-critical SAP applications as part of our global customer support team. The position has the responsibility for researching, troubleshooting and supporting of multiple Client Architectures, and implementations for our global clients who use 4.x, ECC and HANA environments.

Solve complex customer issues using methodical troubleshooting based on expert knowledge of SAP applications functionality and technology.

Work closely with customers on a daily basis to understand their needs, support business change and deliver a consistently high-quality customer experience.

Provide remote-based functional support & training for your specialist SAP modules.

Support client customizations, sharing implementation and best practices advice.

Develop application break fixes for critical product defects.

Create scripts to identify, analyze and correct data issues.

Manage one or more key assigned accounts as a technical/functional advisor.

Provide hands-on assistance using proprietary tools in a test environment or via remote client connectivity.

Be a pro-active contributor to a support organization which is running 24x7x365, this will require the ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays and monitoring email regularly outside standard business hours.

Collaborate with team members in a virtual team environment to extend field experience to different client situations.

Contribute to the development and management of knowledge-sharing methodologies, diagnostic tools, and creative processes, to improve the client experience.

Additional Duties & Responsibilities

Other job-related duties and responsibilities may be assigned from time to time.

Experience

10+ years relevant all-round SAP experience particularly with SAP S4 HANA / Basis.

Working knowledge as a system administrator with at least two of the following: Linux, Solaris, AIX, HP-UX or Windows.

Working knowledge of databases such as Oracle/MS-SQL/DB2/Sybase/SAP HANA.

Expertise in SAP HANA in-Memory Platform core technology, including architecture, landscape design, installation, upgrades, performance tuning, and system migration.

A track record of successful roles in several SAP implementation or upgrade projects.

Deep working knowledge and understanding of supporting business processes.

Knowledge of architecture, implementation, and key functionality.

Expertise with S/4 Hana including full life-cycle implementation experience, configuration, and administration of the application.

Knowledge of maintenance/patching mechanics and SAP architecture.

Demonstrable history solving complex problems across multiple modules.

Experience with ABAP Debug and Troubleshooting.

Nice to have experience with SAP SWPM tool.

Skills

  • Client-facing Support
  • Extreme focus on client satisfaction
  • Analytical, logical problem resolution skills
  • Must be able to speak, read and write English fluently
  • Speak, read, and write another language fluently is desirable
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation and communication skills – verbal & written
  • Superb trouble-shooting skills and tenacity in problem solving
  • Passionate focus on customer support and the ability to build long term, successful working relationships with clients and colleagues
  • Strong knowledge of key application functionality, tables, and relationships
  • Deep knowledge of SAP customization/extension methodologies
  • Attention to detail and the ability to learn quickly
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work calmly and professionally in high pressure situations
  • The ability to work remotely from a home-based office in a virtual environment

Desired Qualifications

  • SAP certification(s) preferred
  • The best candidates will have extensive knowledge of multiple SAP modules across releases (S/4 Hana) including proficiency with SAP product module/suite business processes, navigation mechanics, configuration requirements, integration with other modules and knowledge of underlying technology
  • Knowledge of SAP Industry Solutions would be an advantage
  • Knowledge of any Country Specific Solutions would be an advantage
  • A consulting background, while not mandatory, would be useful
  • Experience with global implementations would be an advantage

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience

Location

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Job function

Engineering and Information Technology

Rimini Street is an equal opportunities employer

title: Oil Processing Engineer -Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Family Relocation Package
description:
Oil Processing Engineer -Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Family Relocation Package

Join to apply for the Oil Processing Engineer -Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Family Relocation Package role at aramco

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Position Description

We are seeking an Oil Processing Engineer to join the Upstream Process Engineering Division part of our Process and Control Systems Department.

The Upstream Process Engineering Division is responsible for providing process engineering expertise, support and consultation in the areas of Gas Processing, Oil and Flow Assurance Applications.

As an Oil Processing Engineer your primary role is to provide specific technical expertise as well as to support and consult in specific areas of Crude Oil Processing.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support for Crude Oil processing operating plants. Troubleshoot major plant upsets and/or chronic operational problems and to identify improvement opportunities, potential problems, and remedies to existing problems.
  • Provide technical lead in the evaluation of Crude Oil Processing and Water Treatment technologies to improve plant’s performance.
  • Develop plans and road maps for reviewing and incorporating new technologies including preliminary economics.
  • Conduct simulations studies process simulation software such as Aspen HYSYS and utilize process models for new and existing facilities to conduct production capacity assessment and identify plant’s bottlenecks.
  • Prepare preliminary scope of work (including process schematic and equipment list) to debottleneck existing facilities or design new facilities.
  • Coordinate the execution of capacity increase studies with operating facilities and detailed engineering design contractor and / or Vendors. This would involve setting the design basis and scope of work as require to ensure study is sufficiently comprehensive to satisfy objective.
  • Create/Update Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards related to Crude Oil Processing.
  • Support process design and engineering activities for new projects in conceptual, pre-FEED, FEED and Detailed Engineering phases.
  • Mentor and develop young Saudi Arab Engineers.
  • Develop new and/or deliver existing technical courses for engineers from operating facilities.
  • Present technical papers in major international conferences and issue papers in reputable oil and gas journals.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering. A Masters or higher education is desirable, but not required.
  • Minimum 20 years of experience working directly with Oil processing such as Gas / Liquid Gravity Separators, Liquid / Liquid Gravity Separators, Electrostatic Coalescers, Crude Stabilizers, Gas Compression Units, Primary and Secondary Water Treatment. With 3 years working with Crude Processing Facilities
  • Membership of a recognized professional institute is preferred.
  • Have adequate design experience in order to take a lead role as the company representative when working with engineering companies performing studies and design activities for Oil Processing projects.
  • Expert in process simulation modelling such as Aspen Hysys.
  • Experience with Computational Fluid Dynamic (CFD) Analysis is preferred.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Seniority level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Engineering, Strategy/Planning, and Business Development

Industries

  • Oil and Gas

description:
Nuuvem é a maior plataforma de distribuição de jogos digitais da América Latina. Com uma presença consolidada no mercado e uma grande paixão por jogos, procuramos um talento para fazer parte da nossa guilda de proplayers, conquistando muito XP ao longo do caminho.

Estamos construindo algo grande: uma plataforma revolucionária que promete transformar a forma como os jogadores acessam e experimentam games. E para isso, buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Marketing apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, experiência em campanhas integradas, redes sociais, PR e construção de comunidades.

Essa pessoa será responsável por estruturar e fortalecer a presença da marca em diferentes canais, conectando-se com públicos estratégicos por meio de uma comunicação criativa, estruturada e orientada a resultados. Atuará de forma estratégica e hands-on, liderando e desenvolvendo o time, além de gerenciar parcerias, conteúdos e relacionamento com influenciadores e stakeholders para gerar engajamento, visibilidade e novos negócios.

Esta oportunidade é válida para trabalho remoto. Fornecemos todos os equipamentos necessários para você mandar bem no seu trabalho, seja ele onde você escolher ser! Você só precisa garantir uma internet de qualidade.

  • Formação completa em Comunicação, Marketing, Publicidade, Jornalismo, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em planejamento e execução de estratégias de go-to-market para produtos digitais, incluindo lançamentos, atualizações e gestão de comunidades.
  • Vivência em relacionamento com influenciadores, parcerias estratégicas (IP, publishers, marcas) e ações de PR, com histórico de geração de visibilidade e engajamento.
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes e interface com diferentes stakeholders, incluindo gestão de community manager, agências e creators.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver e executar planos de comunicação integrados (conteúdo, PR, social orgânica), alinhados aos objetivos do negócio.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em redes sociais, criação de conteúdo e estratégias para crescimento e engajamento de comunidades gamers e devs.
  • Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de planejar e executar ações, incluindo gerenciamento de cronogramas, budget (quando aplicável) e acompanhamento de métricas.
  • Inglês fluente, com segurança para produção de conteúdo, reuniões e contatos com stakeholders internacionais. Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Organização, pensamento estruturado e visão analítica para interpretar dados e ajustar estratégias continuamente.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar e executar estratégias de go-to-market para lançamentos, novas features e SDKs, garantindo visibilidade e engajamento contínuo.
  • Liderar o trabalho da equipe e coordenar ações de comunicação, PR e social orgânica, alinhadas aos objetivos do projeto.
  • Gerenciar relacionamento com influenciadores, publishers, marcas parceiras e demais stakeholders para ampliar alcance e fortalecer a plataforma.
  • Construir e manter relacionamento com desenvolvedores, entendendo suas necessidades e produzindo conteúdos estratégicos (press releases, artigos, vídeos, social posts) voltados para gamedevs e gamers, garantindo consistência de mensagem e comunicação eficaz com a comunidade.
  • Participar de eventos e feiras relevantes do setor (GDC, DevCom/Gamescom, BIG Festival, entre outros), promovendo networking e visibilidade para o projeto.
  • Monitorar KPIs como wishlists, plays, envios de novos jogos e menções espontâneas, propondo melhorias com base em dados.
  • Garantir consistência do tom de voz e posicionamento da marca em todos os canais de comunicação.
  • Colaborar com Produto, Tech e demais áreas para alinhar estratégia de comunicação com o roadmap e as iniciativas da plataforma.

Importante : não deixe de aplicar caso não tenha todos os conhecimentos ou experiências acima! Sua capacidade de aprendizado e evolução é mais importante do que um checklist de conhecimentos e experiências prévias.

Modalidade e Faixa Salarial

A modalidade para essa posição é PJ , com faixa salarial aproximada de R$10.300,00 a R$11.150,00.

Power Ups

  • Plano de Saúde e Odonto : Cuidar da saúde não é brincadeira. Aqui você usufrui de um plano top de linha da AMIL com um desconto de apenas R$1 ao colaborador.
  • Ausência remunerada : 30 dias por ano, a partir de 1 ano de casa para você descansar, viajar, curtir a família, jogar a qualquer hora, etc.
  • Ajuda de Custo Mensal : Todo apoio é bem-vindo! Mensalmente oferecemos R$250,00 no cartão iFood Benefícios (categoria saldo livre) para nosso time estruturar seu ambiente de trabalho, uma internet de qualidade, home office e auxiliar nas contas de casa.

Sem pegadinhas, qualquer funcionário com pelo menos 1 ano de empresa já pode ser escolhido! A regra é clara: crescemos e ganhamos juntos!

Outros atrativos bem legais

Damos flexibilidade para cada time escolher o horário que melhor se encaixe na rotina de seus integrantes, sejam os que acordam pro café da manhã ou pro almoço.
  • Encontros de Time : Não conseguimos ficar muito tempo longe uns dos outros hehe Por isso, anualmente, nosso time inteiro vem para a Cidade Maravilhosa, vulgo Rio de Janeiro, para um momento de interação ao vivo com toda a equipe Nuuvem.
  • Ambiente descontraído , extremamente colaborativo e com alta transparência : Queremos manter sempre nosso ambiente leve, onde todos têm acesso a todos e à todas as informações necessárias. Está em nosso sangue ser co-op. Estamos prontos para ajudar em qualquer ocasião!

  • Equipe Gamer : Aqui somos todos (ou quase todos) gamers! Entendemos e vivemos as dores de quem tem paixão pelos jogos e trabalhamos incessantemente para fazer o melhor para nossa comunidade. title: Outsource Art Producer - Devoted Fusion (Platform)
description:
Devoted Fusion is an end-to-end self-service freelancer hub built for the games industry to help game studios hire pre-vetted artists quickly, transparently, securely, and affordably.

As our Outsource Art Producer, you'll be the first point of contact for both clients and artists using Fusion. You'll be responsible for reviewing incoming project submissions, helping suggest additional freelance talent for projects, and ensuring smooth, fast, and high-quality connections.

You'll also manage and maintain backend systems, workflows, and communication pipelines - speed and precision are crucial. A strong understanding of the gaming industry, art pipelines, and freelance workflows will help you succeed in this role.

This is an ideal position for someone who understands art production pipelines but is looking to transition or expand their skillset to include Business Development also.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and triage new project submissions from game studios
  • Review incoming project needs, work with studios on completing art briefs, and help suggest additional artists for projects
  • Act as the primary point of contact for inbound clients and artists using the Fusion platform
  • Manage client expectations and keep communication clear, fast, and professional
  • Ensure the backend systems (project status, artist availability, profiles, bids, invoicing) are always accurate and up to date
  • Collaborate with internal teams to escalate, support, or troubleshoot challenges
  • Provide status reports, usage feedback, and surface any platform or process improvements

  • Understanding of Linux kernel upstream processes and release cycle

  • Solid background in CI/CD and process automation

What we offer

  • Fluent in one of our main stacks: Java, Kotlin
  • Have experience with AWS cloud services
  • Understand containers, and container orchestration (eg. Kubernetes)

  • Led projects that involved the collaboration of different teams
  • Have experience mentoring less experienced engineers, and interviewing software engineering candidates

title: Senior iOS Engineer
description:
Entrupy is a global technology company whose mission is to protect businesses, borders and consumers from transacting in counterfeit goods. Entrupy has developed a patented technology system which utilizes a combination of AI and computer vision to instantly identify and authenticate high value physical goods.

Entrupy's solutions serve business customers including leading luxury brands, retailers, e-commerce marketplaces and online resellers in over 60 countries. Entrupy is growing quickly with team members based in the US, India, Japan and Brazil. Entrupy's solutions in market:

  • Entrupy Luxury Authentication
  • Entrupy Sneaker Authentication
  • Entrupy Fingerprinting

We're seeking curious, growth minded thinkers to help shape our vision, structures and systems; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you're invigorated by our mission, values, and drive to change the world — we'd love to have you apply.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior iOS Engineer who is passionate about creating intuitive, performant and reliable mobile experiences and SDKs. You will contribute to the Entrupy app, used by our customers to authenticate luxury goods, and the Entrupy SDK, embedded by third‑party developers to power consumer experiences. You'll collaborate closely with your iOS Lead, Product, Design and partners across engineering to deliver high-quality, maintainable software. This role is ideal for someone who values clarity, iterative development and self-directed project ownership in a growing startup.

Reports to iOS Lead

Location : Brazil

Location Type : Remote

Time Zone Expectations : Maintain overlap with US Eastern hours

What you'll do

  • Lead the end‑to‑end iOS feature lifecycle — from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, release and iteration.
  • Build and evolve the Entrupy iOS app and SDK, focusing on usability, performance and reliability.
  • Design clear, stable, and well‑documented SDK APIs that are easy for external developers to integrate, version, and upgrade.
  • Partner with Product and Design to translate requirements into elegant mobile flows, interactions and architecture.
  • Scope and plan projects with ICs and managers; break down work, identify risks and align on milestones and outcomes.
  • Collaborate with backend and platform teams to shape API contracts, data models and performance characteristics that fit mobile usage.
  • Partner with computer vision/ML, backend platform and customer solutions teams on end‑to‑end initiatives.
  • Uphold code quality, testing strategy and CI/CD for iOS; improve modularization, build tooling and release workflows; lead code reviews and technical design reviews to drive consistent engineering standards and best practices.
  • Mentor junior engineers through pairing, feedback and guidance; foster a supportive, feedback‑rich culture.
  • Maintain release health (TestFlight, App Store, crash reporting, analytics) and drive fixes and improvements based on data and feedback.
  • Bring knowledge of AI development tools; share ideas and best practices with the broader team and apply them thoughtfully

What you bring

  • 5–8 years of professional iOS development experience , with a strong track record shipping production apps and/or SDKs.
  • Fluency in Swift and iOS frameworks with strong UIKit experience. Proficiency in Objective‑C (or a strong desire to learn) and comfort working in a mixed Swift/Objective‑C codebase.
  • Experience modernizing legacy codebases and incrementally improving architecture, testability and module boundaries.
  • Strong grasp of mobile architecture patterns (e.g., MVVM, Coordinators), dependency injection and module design.
  • Experience integrating with networked backends (REST), offline caching/sync, background tasks and secure local storage.
  • Proficiency with testing (XCTest, XCUITest) and a pragmatic approach to test coverage and automation.
  • Hands-on with tooling and CI/CD for iOS (e.g., Fastlane, Xcode Cloud, Bitrise or similar) and Swift Package Manager.
  • Clear, empathetic communication skills; ability to influence, align stakeholders and drive clarity across teams.
  • A thoughtful sense of ownership and autonomy; comfortable making well‑reasoned trade‑offs and following through to great outcomes.

Nice to have

  • Experience developing SDKs used by external developers, with strong API design sensibilities and versioning discipline.
  • Background in camera, image capture or image processing or exposure to Core ML/computer vision.
  • Familiarity with Swift frameworks and patterns such as SwiftUI, async/await and Combine.
  • Familiarity with continuous release practices (feature flags, staged rollouts, phased releases).
  • Experience with security and privacy on mobile (keychain, secure enclave, data protection).
  • Knowledge of localization and accessibility best practices.
  • Familiarity with analytics and experimentation frameworks on mobile.
  • Exposure to Android or Web development.
  • Exposure to backend development (e.g., Python).

The starting salary for this role is competitive and will depend on skills and experience. We have competitive pay bands for all other countries based on market standards. Individual compensation decisions are based on several factors, including experience level, skill set and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

Entrupy embraces a diversity of backgrounds and experiences and provides equal opportunity for all applicants and employees. We are dedicated to building a company that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work (and work environment) will be for everyone.

description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role.

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan, have no offices and therefore no pressure to work from an office.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

COMMIS - AUXILIAR DE GARÇOM

Na Belmond, cada refeição é uma experiência inesquecível. Como membro da equipe de Alimentos & Bebidas, você será responsável por criar momentos marcantes com serviço genuíno, caloroso e atento.   • Limpeza e Organização: retirar louças e talheres das mesas, organizar e transportar roupas de mesa limpas e sujas entre salão e rouparia.

  • Atendimento: Auxiliar os garçons no atendimento conforme Padrões da Belmond
  • Comunicação e Suporte: Reportar feedbacks e ocorrências ao supervisor, colaborar na resolução de problemas e acionar a liderança em casos de reclamações para resolução imediata

Requisitos:

  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na função ou cargo semelhante em restaurantes de alta gastronomia
  • Desejável conhecimento em inglês
  • Experiência em restaurante com Estrela Michelin, será um diferencial

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico extensivo a dependentes diretos
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Alimentação no local
  • Folga de Aniversário
  • Descontos nos pontos de vendas da empresa
  • De acordo com o seu "tempo de casa", você adquiri diárias e experiências gratuitas nas propriedades da empresa ao redor do mundo, incluindo 50% de desconto em Alimentos & Bebidas

Nos esforçamos para criar um ambiente onde nossas(os) colaboradoras(es) possam prosperar tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente. Com um compromisso em seu desenvolvimento contínuo, você terá a oportunidade de aprender e crescer ao lado de alguns dos indivíduos mais talentosos do setor. Junte-se a nós e faça parte da criação de momentos inesquecíveis para nossos hóspedes, comunidades e uns aos outros.

title: Página da Vaga | Tech Manager | Remoto
description:
Job description

Em primeiro lugar, queremos te contar um pouco mais sobre quem somos. Vamos lá?

Muito prazer, nós somos a Aurum! Somos uma empresa consolidada no mercado de softwares jurídicos. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais inovadoras para uma nova forma de advogar. Nosso trabalho ajuda milhares de pessoas advogadas a gerenciarem melhor suas tarefas e aumentarem sua produtividade no dia a dia. Legal, né?

Quer saber um segredo? Nós só conseguimos fazer tudo isso porque temos as melhores pessoas aqui.

E como chamamos essa galera? #PessoasÁureas. Hoje somos mais de 200 pessoas espalhadas em todo o Brasil e também contamos com o apoio dos nossos escritórios em Florianópolis (SC) e São Paulo (SP). Não importa onde estamos, a nossa cultura é a mesma, sempre guiada pelos nossos valores.

Aliás, com o apoio de pessoas tão incríveis, valores fortes e uma cultura massa, a gente já conquistou 10 vezes o selo do Great Place to Work e em 2024 ficamos bem posicionados em todos os três rankings que participamos.

E sabe o que buscamos nas pessoas que vão se juntar ao nossO Time?

Estamos em busca de profissionais que valorizem autonomia, responsabilidade, trabalho em time, aprendizado constante, colaboração, comunicação, e claro, proximidade e transparência! Se você se identifica com esse tipo de ambiente, já estamos começando a dar match !

Consideramos única e especial cada pessoa do nosso time, por isso todas são bem vindas, temos um ambiente seguro para os áureos e áureas se expressarem do jeito que são.

Dentro do time de Tecnologia sua missão será: Orquestrar a operação tática de múltiplos squads para transformar a estratégia de Tecnologia em entregas previsíveis, seguras e de alto valor ao negócio, padronizando rituais e métricas, removendo impedimentos e garantindo visibilidade executiva, viabilizando o CTO a atuar focado em nível estratégico.

Ah, uma informação importante sobre essa vaga: o modelo de trabalho proposto é remoto .

Main responsibilities

Agora dá uma olhada nas principais responsabilidades da vaga:

  • Desdobrar OKRs em planos táticos trimestrais e roadmaps integrados; gerenciar calendário de releases; facilitar priorização e gerir dependências entre squads; e conduzir ritos táticos (planning, review, retro, check semanal), garantindo DoR/DoD claros.
  • Padronizar e evoluir o fluxo atrelado às esteiras de desenvolvimento de produto; reduzir retrabalho e lead time; garantir qualidade de releases (gate de release, go/no-go, checklist) e integração com CI/CD e performance; estruturar e acompanhar planos de hardening e redução de débito técnico.
  • Facilitar e apoiar planejamento para automação de testes, cobertura e ambientes de QA; definir SLIs/SLOs com SRE; operar o ciclo de incidentes com CloudOps, SecOps (detecção, resposta, post-mortem e ações corretivas) e TIC; melhorar MTTR/MTBF; incorporar práticas DevSecOps e conformidade (LGPD/ISO/NIST/CIS) no SDLC.
  • Monitorar custo de infra vs. adoção/usuários ativos; promover otimizações e planejamento de capacidade; acompanhar orçamento tático de tecnologia e variações relevantes; apoiar compras/renovações.
  • Manter dashboard tático com throughput, lead/cycle time, bugs por release, disponibilidade, custos, risco e progresso de OKRs; conduzir análises de causa-raiz e planos de melhoria contínua; reportar status e riscos ao CTO.
  • Fazer 1:1s com coordenações/tech leads; dar feedbacks, apoiar trilhas de carreira e sucessão; apoiar atração, seleção e onboarding; fomentar cultura de colaboração, segurança e aprendizagem.
  • Gerenciar RACI, playbooks (SDLC, change management, incidentes), catálogo de serviços e SLAs/SLIs/SLOs; zelar pela documentação viva e pela aderência aos processos acordados.
  • Alinhar prioridades com Produto, CX, Jurídico e áreas de negócio; gerir expectativas com comunicação clara e sem surpresas; conduzir comitês/cerimônias de decisão quando necessário.

Requirements and skills

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

Formação

Sempre que possível, Graduação completa em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência/Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência

  • 7+ anos no ecossistema de desenvolvimento/operações de software;
  • 3+ anos em gestão direta de times e líderes técnicos (coordenações/tech leads);
  • Atuação prévia liderando equipes em negócios de modelo SaaS; e
  • Atuação com equipes multidisciplinares (produto, CX, jurídico, segurança) e gestão de mudanças organizacionais.

Conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

  • SDLC ponta a ponta e rituais ágeis (planning, review, retro) com DoR/DoD claros.
  • CI/CD com gates de qualidade, versionamento, gestão de mudanças e calendário de releases.
  • Cloud (preferencialmente GCP) e práticas de SRE/observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces; SLIs/SLOs).
  • DevSecOps e resposta a incidentes (post-mortem, planos de ação) com noções de LGPD, ISO 27001 e CIS.
  • Capacidade de construir e operar dashboards táticos (engenharia, qualidade, confiabilidade e FinOps básico: custo vs. uso/usuário).

Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação executiva e clareza na gestão de stakeholders.
  • Priorização orientada a valor, pensamento sistêmico e tomada de decisão data-driven.
  • Gestão de conflitos, facilitação de ritos e senso de urgência em incidentes.
  • Liderança de líderes (feedbacks, 1:1s, desenvolvimento de carreira).

Ferramentas e idiomas

  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão do trabalho (ex.: Jira), documentação viva e observabilidade/APM.
  • Inglês técnico e avançado (leitura/escrita e conversação em contexto profissional).

É um diferencial se você tiver:

Experiência setorial

  • Vivência em SaaS B2B de alta disponibilidade; desejável legaltech e integrações com órgãos públicos.
  • Histórico de melhoria de previsibilidade e qualidade com métricas (ex.: lead/cycle time, throughput, bugs por release, SLO/MTTR).

Arquitetura e desenvolvimento

  • Kubernetes/GKE, Terraform/IaC, service mesh, feature flags, blue/green/canary;
  • Arquitetura event-driven (Pub/Sub, Kafka), microsserviços (Java/Spring, 0 Node.js), caching e performance; e
  • Esteiras CI/CD avançadas (gates de qualidade, security scanning, release automation).

SRE, observabilidade e confiabilidade

  • OpenTelemetry, métricas/logs/traces em stack (Grafana/Prometheus/Tempo/Loki) ou APM (Datadog/New Relic); e
  • Definição e operação de SLIs/SLOs/Error Budgets.

Segurança e conformidade

  • Práticas DevSecOps (SAST/DAST/Secrets/IaC scanning), hardening e gestão de vulnerabilidades;
  • Familiaridade com LGPD, ISO 27001/27002 ou CIS Controls e resposta a incidentes com comunicação a clientes; e
  • Experiência com IAM de nuvem e políticas de least privilege.

Dados, IA e automação

  • Pipelines ETL/ELT (data build tool, BigQuery) e governança de dados; e
  • Automação/RPA e aplicações de IA em produtividade/observabilidade/qualidade (ex.: code review assistido).

Gestão, métricas e FinOps

  • Modelagem de OKRs em múltiplos níveis e métricas de fluxo (lead/cycle time, WIP, throughput).
  • FinOps (tagueamento de custos, chargeback/showback, rightsizing e reservas/compromissos).
  • Product/Portfolio ops (roadmapping, dependências, capacity planning).

Additional information

E dá uma olhada no que oferecemos às pessoas #ÁUREAS:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição: R$ 1.100,00 mensais no cartão flexível, sem desconto em folha.
  • Auxílio Home Office: R$ 135,00 mensais no cartão flexível, sem desconto em folha.

  • Plano Odontológico: Bradesco nacional.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Auxílio Creche: Para filhos(as) até 5 anos de idade.
  • Gympass/Wellhub: plataforma de bem-estar, com foco em atividades físicas e saúde integral, com acesso a milhares de academias, estúdios, aulas ao vivo e apps de bem-estar, com apenas uma mensalidade.
  • Conexa Saúde + Psicologia Viva: plataforma de saúde digital, com 2 consultas psicológicas e 2 consultas nutricionais gratuitas por mês.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR) de até dois salários: se o time bate a meta anual, todo mundo ganha participação.

  • E muito mais! Cultura de feedback, guildas de desenvolvimento, PDI no onboarding, Aurum Talks, transparência em OKR e programas de desenvolvimento, entre outros.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to thrive in a lean team environment.
  • Professional-level English communication skills (reading, writing, speaking).

  • Manage the end-to-end recruiting lifecycle: sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, and supporting offers.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates, delivering an excellent and timely candidate experience.

  • Maintain excellence across core recruitment KPIs, including time-to-fill, source-of-hire, pipeline conversion, and candidate/hiring manager satisfaction.

  • Collaborate with the TA leadership and hiring teams to align on workforce planning and support talent development initiatives.
  • Uphold and continuously improve best practices across recruitment operations—including job postings, social campaigns, ATS workflows, and candidate communications.
  • Represent phData with professionalism, integrity, and alignment to our mission, vision, and core values.

Who You Are

  • Innovative – You’re eager to test new approaches and continuously improve.
  • Curious – You love to learn and stay ahead of recruiting trends.
  • Adaptable – You thrive in change and adjust quickly to evolving business needs.
  • Process-Driven – You identify opportunities for efficiency and implement improvements.
  • Tech-Savvy – You’re comfortable navigating recruiting systems and tools.
  • Energetic – You bring enthusiasm and urgency to a fast-paced environment.
  • Results-Oriented – You’re motivated by achieving goals and connecting world-class talent with meaningful opportunities.
  • Connected – You stay current with industry trends and maintain a strong recruiter network while engaging with talent communities.

Why phData?

Descrição da vaga

Mais do que simples fornecedores de tecnologia, nos destacamos como verdadeiros especialistas em logística. Nossas soluções são moldadas pela vasta experiência que acumulamos ao longo dos anos, refletindo a sabedoria e os aprendizados adquiridos ao longo de nossa jornada. Por mais de 25 anos, trabalhamos com operações logísticas de grande escala, servindo a uma variedade de setores, incluindo indústrias, varejistas, operadores logísticos e transportadoras. Mantendo um olhar perspicaz sobre as tendências do mercado, desenvolvemos sistemas adaptáveis que se ajustam às necessidades em constante evolução de nossos clientes.

Nossa trajetória de pioneirismo ao longo dos últimos anos nos proporcionou um amplo know-how e expertise em todas as nuances do setor logístico. Essa jornada nos permitiu acumular valiosa experiência e nos destacar como líderes em oferecer as melhores práticas do mercado.

Além de nosso conhecimento aprofundado, a segurança é uma prioridade essencial para nós. Somos certificados pela ISO/IEC 27001, garantindo que adotemos os mais rigorosos padrões em segurança da informação, demonstrando nosso compromisso com a proteção de nossos parceiros e clientes.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Analista de Qualidade. Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

  • Identificar, registrar e acompanhar defeitos, garantindo sua resolução em conjunto com o time de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar ativamente com equipes de desenvolvimento e negócio, aplicando comunicação clara e análise crítica na definição de requisitos e critérios de aceitação;

  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review, retrospectiva), trazendo visão crítica e foco em melhoria contínua;
  • Contribuir com a definição e padronização de processos de QA, disseminando boas práticas de qualidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Solidas experiência como QA em processos de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência em teste manual e automatizado como: Criação, manutenção, execução e análise de resultados;
  • Experiência em testes de API;
  • Conhecimentos com Framework como: Selenium, Cypress, Playwright ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL para validação de dados);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (ex: Scrum, Kanban);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de tarefas e bugs (ex.: ClickUp, Azure DevOps, Jira, Trello ou similares);

Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade.

Estamos Empenhados Em Gerar Impacto Para a Sociedade, Clientes, Colaboradores e Acionistas, e Queremos Somar Forças Com Pessoas Cheias De Energia e Propósito Para Fazer Parte De Nossa Equipe e Dessa Transformação.

description:
Senior Full Stack Developer with UX/UI Focus (Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior com foco em UX/UI)

Company Overview

Dadosfera is transforming the data landscape with a platform that delivers advanced Data, AI, and Analytics capabilities—previously available only to tech giants like Meta, Amazon, Alphabet, and Microsoft—into the hands of small and medium-sized businesses. By democratizing access to these technologies, we empower our clients to accelerate business opportunities through AI-powered Data Apps.

Our platform minimizes the time spent on cloud management and streamlines the entire data lifecycle—from collection and exploration to processing and interaction—allowing clients to focus on their business goals. Built on a high-growth SaaS model, Dadosfera offers tailored solutions that meet real business needs.

What sets Dadosfera apart is our innovative focus on speed, scalability, and flexibility, combining big data storage with advanced analytics to drive strategic decision-making. Leveraging years of experience with data platform implementations on foreign public clouds, we now deliver a cost-effective, locally adapted solution tailored for both Brazilian and global markets. By blending deep expertise with localized infrastructure, Dadosfera provides a powerful, efficient tool that optimizes corporate data management and drives data-driven transformation.

About the Job


We’re looking for a highly skilled Full-Stack Engineer with strong UX/UI design capabilities to lead the complete redesign and rebuild of our company website. This role blends visual design, front-end engineering, and light back-end work — and demands a strong sense of ownership, autonomy, and cross-functional collaboration.

You’ll be responsible for designing a completely new web experience from scratch (in Figma or similar), implementing it in production-ready code, and ensuring that all app and product functionality currently tied to the website continues to work seamlessly after the redesign. The website is a core part of our commercial strategy and online sales funnel — your work will directly impact the future of the company.

You’ll work closely with the CEO, CTO, COO and Marketing to translate vision into execution. You’ll also help define foundational UX and design systems for future iterations.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the complete redesign and implementation of our website.
  • Create wireframes and high-fidelity designs using tools like Figma.
  • Translate designs into scalable, responsive code using React, Next.js, and TailwindCSS (or equivalent); Angular is a bonus.
  • Refactor the existing codebase while preserving complex app/product interdependencies.
  • Optimize the site for performance, responsiveness, and accessibility.
  • Collaborate with leadership to ensure the site aligns with commercial goals (especially online sales flows and billing system integration).
  • Propose and implement architectural improvements where needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in full-stack development with a strong front-end focus.
  • Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, Tailwind (or similar frameworks).
  • Solid back-end experience with Node.js and Python.
  • Demonstrated experience creating and implementing end-to-end designs (Figma or similar).
  • Proven ability to manage complex interdependencies and refactor production code without disruption.
  • Experience working closely with commercial or marketing teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building checkout, billing, or payment flows (and tracking the usage of users).
  • Familiarity with web analytics tools.
  • Ability to improve existing design system or reusable component library.
  • Background working in startups or fast-paced environments.
  • Intermediate or higher English fluency.

At Dadosfera, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment every day. We have zero tolerance for any form of discrimination. Do you share our values? Then don’t wait—apply today!
